evidence.reason: The fetch at line 909 supplies only a colon-less source ref and does not pass `--refmap=`. Git still applies `remote.origin.fetch` mappings to command-line refs by default, so a configured mapping such as `+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main` can force-update local `main` when it is not checked out. That bypasses the protected-ref guard, which checks only explicit refspec destinations. This is an implementation defect in the intended protected-ref behavior, not a new requirement; the smallest fix is to pin an empty refmap for this fetch (and the analogous `fetchRef` path, updating the safeArgs allowlist accordingly).
